introduction_markdown:
**Cameroon General Certificate of Education Board - Ordinary Level Examination. Computer Science (0595), Paper 3 (practical), Group Three, June 2019. Duration: two and a half hours. Do all the tasks (Task I, Task II and Task III) specified in this question paper.**

Enter the information required in the shaded boxes. For your guidance, the approximate mark for each part of a question is indicated in brackets. You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. All written answers should be provided in the spaces provided in this question booklet. Calculators are NOT allowed.

The booklet reproduced here is the Group Three version (booklet 00/0595/3A/Grp 3); a candidate sits only one group. Task I and Task II are done on a computer (word processor and spreadsheet); Task III is a short programming exercise (C or Pascal).
enonce_intro_markdown:
**TASK II (20 marks)**

The members of a certain village meeting make contributions for Sinking Fund (SF), Savings (S) and other Contributions (C). From each of these headings money to compensate the executive members is deducted. This money is calculated by multiplying the amount in each heading by its coefficient. The total per member is then the sum of the amounts from the different headings. The situation of payments at the end of October in a certain year can be seen in Figure 2.

![fig-1](gce-ol-computer-science-2019-p3-officiel-cameroun_exercice_G3-T2_fig_1.png)

*Figure 2: the worksheet. The column headings are at the top (with MONEY FOR COMPENSATION above FROM SF, FROM S, FROM C and TOTAL PER MEMBER), the ten members are in rows 3 to 12 (S/NO in column A, NAME OF MEMBER in B, TOTAL SF in C, TOTAL S in D, TOTAL C in E), and the coefficients are in C16 (SF COEFFICIENT 0.05), C17 (S COEFFICIENT 0.08) and C18 (C COEFFICIENT 0.07). Columns F to J are empty.*

Perform the following:

figures.legende: Figure 2 : feuille de calcul des contributions (SF, S, C) des dix membres et des coefficients

Il contient trois tâches : Task I (traitement de texte, 20 points), Task II (tableur, 20 points) et Task III (programme C ou Pascal, 10 points). Les valeurs ont été relues sur l'image (montants des colonnes C, D, E et coefficients 0,05 / 0,08 / 0,07).

Tous les résultats chiffrés (colonnes F, G, H, I, remarques, totaux) ont été recalculés avec Python à partir des données de la figure : totaux 2 275, 108 400, 10 500 et 121 175 ; la formule de la question 9 a été traduite en Python (I < 12000) : 6 mentions INSUFFICIENT et 4 SUFFICIENT. Question 9 : « a members contribution » est lu comme le total par membre de la colonne I (TOTAL PER MEMBER). Avec les totaux bruts C + D + E, tous les membres dépasseraient largement 12000 et le test n'aurait aucun sens ; le seuil de 12000 est cohérent avec les montants de la colonne I (6 325 à 24 500). « Not up to 12000 » est lu comme « strictement inférieur à 12000 ».

Lecture retenue : le total général de la colonne TOTAL PER MEMBER avec SUM (121 175) ; l'autre lecture possible (total brut de chaque membre, C + D + E) est donnée dans le corrigé. Le barème du jury et la lecture attendue sont inconnus.
Les formules utilisent la syntaxe anglaise standard (séparateur virgule dans IF) ; avec un tableur configuré en français, le séparateur est le point-virgule.

questions.corrige_markdown:
The appropriate application is a **spreadsheet** (for example *Microsoft Excel* or *LibreOffice Calc*): the task needs rows, columns and formulas. A word processor or a database would be wrong because the values must be calculated.

1. Open the spreadsheet program and a new blank workbook.
2. Key in the headings: **S/NO**, **NAME OF MEMBER**, **TOTAL SF**, **TOTAL S**, **TOTAL C**, **FROM SF**, **FROM S**, **FROM C**, **TOTAL PER MEMBER**, **REMARKS**, and the group heading **MONEY FOR COMPENSATION** above columns F to I (it can be merged and centred over F:I).
3. Key in the ten members in rows 3 to 12: the serial numbers 1 to 10 in column A, the names in column B, and the amounts in columns C, D and E exactly as in Figure 2 (numbers only, no currency symbol, so that they can be used in formulas).
4. Key in the labels **SF COEFFICIENT**, **S COEFFICIENT**, **C COEFFICIENT** in B16, B17, B18 and the coefficients **0.05**, **0.08**, **0.07** in C16, C17, C18.
5. Check every number against Figure 2 (a single wrong digit gives wrong results later).

Marking idea (4 marks): suitable software (spreadsheet) opened (1); headings and names keyed correctly (1); amounts in columns C to E correct (1); coefficients in C16:C18 correct (1).

questions.enonce_markdown: Write down the formula to calculate the money for compensation from SF in cell F3. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The money from SF for a member is the member's total SF multiplied by the SF coefficient, which is stored once in C16. The coefficient must be **fixed** (absolute reference) so that it does not move when the formula is copied down.

**F3: `=C3*$C$16`**

Without the dollar signs, copying the formula to F4 would give `=C4*C17`, which uses the wrong cell (the S coefficient). Check for ESUA: $6000 \times 0.05 = 300$.

Marking idea (2 marks): multiplication of C3 by the coefficient (1); coefficient cell C16 made absolute, `$C$16` (1).

questions.enonce_markdown: Calculate the money for compensation from SF for each member. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Type `=C3*$C$16` in F3, then copy it down to F12 (select F3, drag the fill handle at the bottom right corner of the cell down to F12, or double-click the handle). Each row uses its own TOTAL SF and always the same coefficient C16 = 0.05.

questions.enonce_markdown: Write down the formula in cell J3 that would insert the word INSUFFICIENT if a members contribution is not up to 12000 and SUFFICIENT otherwise. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Use the logical function **IF**. The test is on the member's total contribution towards the compensation (cell I3). "Not up to 12000" means **less than 12000** (a member who reaches exactly 12000 is SUFFICIENT).

**J3: `=IF(I3<12000,"INSUFFICIENT","SUFFICIENT")`**

The words are written between double quotation marks because they are text. Copied down to J12, the formula gives:

| Row | Member | TOTAL PER MEMBER | REMARKS |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | ESUA | 9 700 | INSUFFICIENT |
| 4 | KILIAN | 21 275 | SUFFICIENT |
| 5 | LILIAN | 14 000 | SUFFICIENT |
| 6 | MBENG | 24 500 | SUFFICIENT |
| 7 | NICOLLINE | 6 325 | INSUFFICIENT |
| 8 | OJONG | 7 925 | INSUFFICIENT |
| 9 | PAUL | 8 650 | INSUFFICIENT |
| 10 | QUEENTA | 6 710 | INSUFFICIENT |
| 11 | ROSTARD | 12 950 | SUFFICIENT |
| 12 | SMITH | 9 140 | INSUFFICIENT |

Six members (ESUA, NICOLLINE, OJONG, PAUL, QUEENTA, SMITH) are INSUFFICIENT and four (KILIAN, LILIAN, MBENG, ROSTARD) are SUFFICIENT. An equivalent formula is `=IF(I3>=12000,"SUFFICIENT","INSUFFICIENT")`.

Marking idea (2 marks): IF function with the correct condition on I3 (1); the two words correctly placed in quotation marks (1).

questions.enonce_markdown: Calculate the total that each member has contributed so far towards the compensation of executive member's for that year. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The sentence is close to question 8. Two readings are possible; the first one is the one retained, the second is given as a check.

1. **Total of the column TOTAL PER MEMBER** (what all the members have contributed together towards the executive's compensation). In **I13** type **`=SUM(I3:I12)`**, which gives **121 175**. In the same way `=SUM(F3:F12)` gives 2 275, `=SUM(G3:G12)` gives 108 400 and `=SUM(H3:H12)` gives 10 500; and $2275 + 108400 + 10500 = 121175$.
2. **If the question asks for each member's own total contribution** (all that the member has paid in the three headings), use `=C3+D3+E3` in a free column and copy it down (for ESUA: $6000 + 100000 + 20000 = 126000$).

Marking idea (2 marks): use of the SUM function (or an addition) (1); correct total (1).
